after.reads: Face at arm's length, held still for the line; cut to the session prices at the desk.

price.reads: The price list grows until the session line fills the frame; hold for the outro.

demo.reads: The coach moves through one rep from below; match-cut on the coach to eye level.

coach.reads: The coach holds still in the back camera while the creator speaks; cut to straight above the feet.

stance.reads: Feet or hands settle into position from above; cut to the wide floor shot of the creator.

copy.reads: The creator repeats the move in a wide frame from the floor; cut to the front camera.

verdict.reads: Face at arm's length, still; cut to the schedule on the wall.

class.reads: The schedule grows until the class time fills the frame; hold for the outro.

room.reads: The door frame slides away and the dressed table appears; cut to the menu from straight above.

menu.reads: A finger lands on one line of the menu from above; cut to the practitioner at eye level.

walkthrough.reads: The practitioner talks in the back camera, held still; cut to above the creator's hands.

during.reads: Hands rest still on the towel from above; match-cut on the creator to the front camera after.

after.reads: Face at arm's length, still; cut to the name plate at the entrance.

sign.reads: The name plate shrinks as the entrance appears around it; hold for the outro.

door.reads: The door grows until it fills the frame; the next shot opens on the waiting room behind a pillar or plant.

waiting.reads: The blocker slides away and the empty waiting room opens up; cut to the selfie with the clinician.

meet.reads: Two faces at arm's length, held still; the camera flips to the back lens on the room.

tools.reads: The kit grows in the back camera while the creator speaks; cut to the price list from above.

price.reads: The price line held still from above; cut to the front camera outside.

verdict.reads: Face and entrance at arm's length, held still for the outro.
